name: design-token-table
title: Design token table
description: Design tokens documented as a table: each drawn as itself, with its value and a copy button, a filter that marks matches, folding groups and a link per token.
docs: Pass tokens ({ name, value, type, usage, group, contrast }) where type is color, size, radius, shadow, font or duration. The preview draws the value itself: a swatch (over a checkerboard when it is see-through), a bar as long as a length, a corner for a radius, a raised tile for a shadow, a font specimen, and for a duration a track that grows with the time (a second is the whole width) with a dot that runs along it for that long when the row is hovered or has focus (under reduced motion it stays put). The value is mono with a copy button. Groups fold (defaultFolded names the ones that start folded), and the filter matches name or value, marks what matched and opens every group that has a match. Each name links to its own row (idPrefix goes before every anchor when two tables share a page); a link to a token inside a folded group opens the group and scrolls to the token. Name a colour token in background and every colour shows its WCAG contrast against it as a ratio and a grade in words with a glyph; a colour the table cannot read (hsl, a name, a var) shows none, and contrast: false leaves one out. Narrower than 56rem the table becomes one card per token. onCopy is called after a copy and labels translates every word.
